## English

- Resize the Slurm jobs card vertically using the grip at its bottom. The chosen height is saved locally and restored after restarting; double-click the grip to reset it.
- Keep the chosen height while refreshing, switching between My jobs and All jobs, or changing servers. Support arrow-key resizing and automatic page scrolling when dragging near the window edge.
- Fix a simulated SSH server test that could block after an output overflow, making cross-platform release checks reliable.

## 简体中文

- Slurm 作业卡片支持拖动底部横条调整高度，自动保存并在下次启动时恢复；双击横条可恢复默认高度。
- 刷新、切换个人／全部范围或切换服务器时保留高度，支持方向键调整，以及拖到窗口边缘时自动滚动页面。
- 修复模拟 SSH 服务器在输出超限后可能阻塞的测试问题，提高跨平台发布检查的稳定性。
